title: Spotify Clone
highlights: Built a responsive Spotify-inspired web app with search, playlists, and playback.
Integrated Spotify Web API for live songs, artists, and albums.
Implemented global state management with Redux.
Ensured smooth navigation and persistent playback using React Router.

title: Fitness Management System
highlights: Created a full-stack app for managing fitness and diet plans by goal and budget.
Added goal-based workout categories (weight gain, fat loss, muscle building).
Built a calorie calculator to guide daily intake.
